purpose: Provenance for the frozen C3-A microcost corpus (P2 follow-up from the C3-A review). Option A: manifest with the deterministic selection rule and identity SHAs; the corpus file itself stays local-only (data/s10/ is gitignored).
selection_rule: first 10,000 records of data/s10/s10-eval-v1-300k01/part-0000.jsonl (dataset order) that are (a) split != holdout and (b) labels.jsonl teacher_cp_stm != null; emitted as 'position_id|fen' lines
note: The corpus can be regenerated from the frozen B1 dataset with the rule above; the corpus SHA pins the artifact actually measured in s10-c3a-microcost.json.
